rules.source_preservation: Original Markdown activity libraries remain authoritative and unchanged.
rules.selection: Mason Forge creates project pick lists from plan-detected scope and pulls only matching master records.
rules.project_copy: Project records reference master IDs and store project-specific quantities, durations, calendars, locations and dates separately.
rules.duration: Master activity duration is null until calculated from project quantity, production, crew, calendar, weather and constraints.
rules.visual_layer: Web cards render project data; visual components are not the master knowledge store.
